newsitem.title: USA: Expeditors opens India, Bangladesh offices.
newsitem.headline: Expeditors opens India, Bangladesh offices.

text.p: Expeditors International said it has opened offices in New Delhi and the Bangladeshi cities of Dhaka and Chittagong.

Expeditors said in a statement that each is a full-service office with air and ocean freight forwarding services, supplier consolidation, customs clearance, cargo insurance, distribution and logistics services.
Rommel Saber, Expeditors' director for the Middle East and Indian subcontinent, said the Indian export economy is becoming more diversified, while textile exports from Bangladesh are increasing.
"India continues to be a leader in textile production, and now we're seeing a rise in the export of spare parts and computer products," he said.
The New Delhi office is Expeditors's first in India. The Seattle-based forwarder said it works with agents in major cities, including Bombay, Bangalore, Madras and Calcutta.
The New Delhi location, operating under the name "Expeditors International (India) Pvt Ltd," is supervised by Kurt Meister, managing director - India.

In Bangladesh, the new offices are operating as "Expeditors (Bangladesh) Ltd" and are supervised by Syed Ershad Ahmed, former Expeditors' resident manager in Dhaka who becomes managing director for Bangladesh. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel +44 171 542 8982 Fax +44 171 542 5017
